title: Chaos Erupts After 2 Moms Fight At Baseball Game
description:
It was supposed to be just another afternoon at her child’s baseball game, yet somehow, she ended up here. At first, this timid mom seemed to cooperate fully with the officers, calm and compliant—until she suddenly decided to garnish one officer’s mustache with a generous serving of throat soup. Remember when Jesus used to heal people? She's the reason he stopped. And in case there was any doubt about who brought the chaos, well, the only bomber here is you, love. Unsurprisingly, mama was charged with disorderly intoxication and battery on a peace officer.
